segments.he:
א.

עַל יְדֵי סְפִירַת הָעֹמֶר נִצּוֹלִין מִגֵּרוּשׁ.
segments.en: Through counting of the omer, there is saving from expulsion.

segments.he:
ב.

בְּיוֹתֵר צָרִיךְ לְהִזָּהֵר לִטְבֹּל לְקִרְיוֹ בִּימֵי עֹמֶר.
segments.en: Through counting of the omer, there is saving from expulsion.

segments.he:
ג.

בִּסְפִירַת הָעֹמֶר יְכוֹלִין לְהַכְנִיעַ אֶת הַמָּסוּר. וְסִימָן: לָעֹמֶר - רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת מֵ'אִיגְּרָא רָ'מָא לְ'בִירָא עֲ'מִיקְתָּא.
segments.en:
Extra special care must be taken to dip [in a Mikveh] for one’s accidental emission during the days of the omer.

In the counting of the omer it is possible to subdue an informer. A sign for this: “LaOMeR” [- to the omer – this is how the Omer is counted: 1 or 49 days to the Omer] this is an acronym for: “Me’igra Rama L’bira Ohmikta” (from a high roof to a deep pit).
